Game Overview

In Space Battleship Orion, the core idea is straightforward: command the Space Battleship Orion in a fast-paced arcade shooter set in a captivating galaxy. Master precision firing and tactical evasion to outlast waves of adversaries. Collect defeated enemies' items to skyrocket your score in this thrilling interstellar adventure. Can you conquer the cosmos?
